stories.title: ‘Human error’ saw detainees dropped off in Edmonton streets: Alberta safety minister

en.title: 'Human error' saw detainees dropped off in Edmonton streets: Alberta safety minister
en.summary: Alberta's Public Safety Minister Mike Ellis attributed the improper release of detainees onto Edmonton streets to human error. Corrections officials plan to implement measures to prevent similar incidents from occurring.

stories.title: Donald Trump gifts Xi Jinping eagle statue at state dinner, as Xi suggests countries' goals can be complementary

en.title: Donald Trump gifts Xi Jinping eagle statue at state dinner, as Xi suggests countries' goals can be complementary
en.summary: Donald Trump hosted a state dinner featuring technology industry guests where he presented Xi Jinping with an eagle statue. Xi indicated that both countries' objectives could align.

stories.title: Supreme Court rejects a Trump-backed Missouri congressional map for the third time

en.title: Supreme Court rejects a Trump-backed Missouri congressional map for the third time
en.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court declined to hear a challenge regarding a Missouri congressional map supported by President Trump. The decision may resolve a prolonged legal dispute occurring during midterm election voting.

stories.title: Broncos get a boost as tailbacks J.K. Dobbins, RJ Harvey appear ready to lead charge against Rams

en.title: Broncos get a boost as tailbacks J.K. Dobbins, RJ Harvey appear ready to lead charge against Rams
en.summary: Denver Broncos running backs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey are ready to play in an upcoming game against the Rams. Dobbins had committed to participating in all 17 games this season.

en.title: Dock photo crop
en.summary: Illegal charter boat operations at Sugar Beach are discharging passengers at unauthorized locations without proper docking facilities, creating safety risks for those aboard.

stories.title: Photos offer a glimpse inside Argentina disability care home Pope Leo XIV will visit in November

en.title: Photos offer a glimpse inside Argentina disability care home Pope Leo XIV will visit in November
en.summary: A Buenos Aires facility for people with disabilities is preparing to receive a papal visit in November, with residents participating in various activities at the residence.

stories.title: Police, fire or ambulance? Winnipeg launching 4th option for 911 mental health calls

en.title: Police, fire or ambulance? Winnipeg launching 4th option for 911 mental health calls
en.summary: Winnipeg city council is developing a community crisis response model to provide specialized support for 911 callers experiencing mental health and addiction-related emergencies.

stories.title: Veteran OPP sergeant charged following child sexual exploitation investigation

en.title: Veteran OPP sergeant charged following child sexual exploitation investigation
en.summary: An Ontario Provincial Police sergeant with 28 years of service has been charged with child sexual abuse material offenses following an investigation in Alliston.

stories.title: Class action sought after alleged abuse of students at N.S. school

en.title: Class action sought after alleged abuse of students at N.S. school
en.summary: RCMP received a report in September of an alleged assault at a Nova Scotia school serving students from pre-primary through Grade 8. A class action lawsuit is being pursued in response to the incident.

stories.title: Alberta NDP files court challenge over province’s new restricted voter list rules

en.title: Alberta NDP files court challenge over province's new restricted voter list rules
en.summary: Alberta's Opposition NDP is challenging new government regulations that limit the sharing of voter information with political parties. The party is pursuing legal action against the restrictions.

stories.title: B.C.’s Eby says NDP would tax new, unsold condos, raise speculation, vacancy fees

en.title: B.C.'s Eby says NDP would tax new, unsold condos, raise speculation, vacancy fees
en.summary: British Columbia's NDP leader proposes taxing new unsold condominiums and increasing speculation and vacancy fees, citing thousands of vacant units worth billions across Metro Vancouver.

stories.title: Afternoon front page: CBC journalist disciplined over post on anti-Israel protest; synagogue attacker sued military over COVID vaccine mandate; and more

en.title: Afternoon front page: CBC journalist disciplined over post on anti-Israel protest; synagogue attacker sued military over COVID vaccine mandate; and more
en.summary: A CBC journalist faced disciplinary action for a social media post regarding an anti-Israel protest, and a synagogue attacker pursued legal action against the military over a COVID vaccine mandate.

stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Bombardier CEO says defence business a significant opportunity
en.summary: Bombardier's CEO believes the company can expand into defence by adapting business jets for military use. He points to their partnership with Saab on the GlobalEye surveillance aircraft as evidence of capability.

en.title: Alberta business leaders hesitant to step into separation debate
en.summary: Alberta business executives remain supportive of Canada and express concern that separation could harm investment and economic growth.

en.summary: Canada's Competition Bureau will investigate grocery pricing policies, building on a 2023 study suggesting increased competition could lower prices and encourage innovation.

stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Potash giant Canpotex investing $500-million in Vancouver port terminal to increase exports
en.summary: Canpotex is investing $500 million in a Vancouver port terminal to boost potash exports, as BHP's Jansen production facility in Saskatchewan prepares to begin operations in mid-2027.

en.summary: PowerCo Canada has postponed the start of operations for its $7-billion electric vehicle battery facility in St. Thomas to 2029.
